articleTitle: UAV path planning based on improved particle swarm algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: As one of the key technologies to realize the autonomy of UAVs, path planning is one of the key issues in the field of UAVs. The results of the existing traditional algorithms for path planning are difficult to meet the increasingly complex environment and task requirements. Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional particle swarm algorithm, this research improves the weight and learning factor of particle swarm. The proposed new algorithm can efficiently plan autonomous paths for UAVs, thereby effectively improving the operating environment of UAVs and providing help for applications in related industries. Finally, this research was simulated by MATLAB software to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of Downlink Coverage and Capacity for 3D Mobile UAV Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Since traditional cellular network analysis does not consider the random distribution and irregular movement of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV s) in three-dimensional (3-D) space, it is not suitable for high-density urban areas. Therefore, this paper follows the random geometry theory and mobile ad hoc network (MANET) to construct a 3-D Poisson point process (PPP) mobile UAV network model that allows UAVs to move freely in 3-D space. In this model, we consider that the ground user equipment (GUE) uses the nearest neighbor association strategy and the random association strategy to select the UAV as the serving base station (SBS), and the rest are the interfering base stations (IBS). Then, through the Laplace transform of the distance distribution between the UAV and the user and the interference of other base stations, it is derived that the downlink network coverage under the two associated strategies is proportional to the channel capacity. Finally, through simulation and theoretical analysis, we find that the nearest neighbor association strategy is significantly better than the random association strategy, and as the path loss exponents increases, the coverage and channel capacity are increasing.

articleTitle: Intelligent surveillance and reconnaissance mode of police UAV based on grid
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: The panoramic security prevention and control mode of "UAV + police officer" breaks the disadvantages of traditional patrols, which requires a lot of manpower and material resources. However, it has limited control range and is not suitable for real-time dynamic monitoring of large scenes and large areas. In response to the above problems, this article proposes a new police drone intelligent surveillance and reconnaissance mode, which introduces the grid concept, fixed-point monitoring mode and multi-machine collaboration technology, which can be applied to large scenes and large areas in real-time dynamic monitoring. surveillance effectively improves the detection efficiency of police drones in surveillance technology investigations.

articleTitle: Research on Promotion of Lower Limb Movement Function Recovery after Stroke by Using Lower Limb Rehabilitation Robot in Combination with Constant Velocity Muscle Strength Training
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: In order to observe the correlation between lower limb rehabilitation robot and isokinetic muscle strength training after stroke on their lower limb motor function. We collected 90 stroke patients treated in our rehabilitation center from April 2018 to may 2020 and divided them into three groups by sampling method. Group A was assisted by lower limb rehabilitation robot training, group B was given isokinetic muscle strength training, and group C was assisted by lower limb rehabilitation robot coordinated isokinetic muscle strength training. Finally, we obtained the following results: compared with before intervention, FMA, Holden walking function classification, BBS and peak torque of three groups were significantly improved after 6 weeks of intervention (P <; 0.05), and BBS score and angular velocity (60, 120, 180 ° / s) of extensor and knee flexor in group C were significantly increased compared with group A and group B (P <; 0.05), and there was no significant difference between group A and group B (P > 0.05). In this paper, the effect of lower limb rehabilitation robot combined with isokinetic muscle strength training after stroke is ideal, which can effectively improve the motor function of lower limbs, and also promote the improvement of muscle strength, balance and walking ability, which is worthy of reference.

articleTitle: Application of Ceramic 3D Printing Technology in Modern Ceramic Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: This paper starts with the analysis of ceramic 3D printing technology, which is divided into two parts: the classification of ceramic 3D printing technology and the concept of ceramic 3D printing technology. Then it concretely analyzes the application of ceramic 3D printing technology in modern ceramic production, including decoration, molding and materials in modern ceramic production. Finally, the advantages of 3D printing technology for modern ceramics production are analyzed, including free ceramic modeling, simple skill requirements, simplified manufacturing process and fast molding time. It is hoped that ceramic related personnel can pay attention to the application of ceramic 3D printing technology in modern ceramic production and highlight the advantages of ceramic 3D printing technology.

articleTitle: Application Prospects of New Information Technology in Aviation Maintenance Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Information technology represents the development direction of advanced productivity. The wide application of information technology plays an important role in production factors and strategic resources, thereby promoting the continuous upgrading of traditional industries, improving social labor productivity and social operating benefit. In aircraft maintenance practices, the feasible utilization of information technology such as Big Data analysis, Internet of Things mode, AI Scenarios, can improve maintenance efficiency and safety. Establishing maintenance data analysis system, technical data analyzation, intelligent expert troubleshooting system, materials and tools sharing system, can be beneficial to allocate integrated resources, implement safety management comprehensively, and dynamically achieve the purpose of controlling or reducing risks to an acceptable safety level.

articleTitle: Grid Line Tracking Omnidirectional Robot Based on Visible Light Sensor and Mecanum Wheel PID Control
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Our design is a omnidirectional mobile robot which can move across a 2D working condition in a programmable way. The robot takes STM32 microprocessor as control module, adopts PWM pulse to control DC motor with encoder. DC motor and Mecanum Wheel speed control uses closed-loop PID Control Algorithms. The line-tracking and positioning module is based on visible light gray sensor which is distributed in all four possible movement direction to take advantage of the omnidirectional movement of the Mecanum wheel, allowing the robot to switch between horizontal and vertical movement directly. The relevant experiments show that the movement solution meet all the design requirements.

articleTitle: Multi-UAV Task Allocation Based on Type Mamdani Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: This article for multi-UAV multi-objective task assignment problem, the application of fuzzy reasoning to solve multi-UAV task allocation problem is studied, this paper proposes a simple type Mamdani fuzzy logic-based multi-UAV task allocation model. Taking the threat value of combat targets and the determination of the chief executive as the dual inputs, and the combination of multi-UAV execution tasks as the single output, the Mamdani-type fuzzy inference system is constructed to fuzzify the input and output in the system, the inference rules and the key links such as inference synthesis algorithm are briefly introduced.

articleTitle: Research on modeling method of industrial load controllable characteristics based on multi-objective optimization method algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: In order to fully tap the regulatory potential of industrial load, it is necessary to build an adjustable resource pool of typical industrial enterprises. This article first accurately models typical industrial loads, optimizes industrial load operation with the goal of economy, selects various types of electrolytic aluminum enterprises load as the research object. Then aiming at the lowest cost of electricity and the highest user satisfaction, the dual-objective optimization is carried out. Finally, the dual-objective optimal dispatch of industrial load can improve the economic efficiency of industrial enterprises and reduce the cost of electricity purchase of industrial enterprises.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis technology of substation indoor inspection robot based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of power grid scale, the inspection technology of substation indoor inspection robot is widely used in the process of power system detection. In order to ensure the operation effect of inspection robot, the optimization of fault diagnosis technology of substation indoor inspection robot based on SVM is proposed. The optimization model of terminal configuration is proposed, and the research requirements of fault classification and diagnosis for inspection robot are designed by collecting fault information of indoor inspection robot in substation. Experiments show that the fault diagnosis technology of substation indoor inspection robot based on SVM can improve the quality and identification accuracy of substation indoor inspection robot, and thus confirm that the fault diagnosis technology of substation indoor inspection robot based on SVM can better improve the operation efficiency of equipment and fully meet the research requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Turnout Fault Classification Diagnosis Based on SOM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Turnout equipment is an important part of railroad equipment, which plays an important role in railroad safety operation and security. This paper analyzes the fault phenomenon of turnouts, takes its current curve as the research object. Data features are extracted and fault is diagnosed by SOM algorithm. It provides theoretical basis and practical experience for the maintenance of railroad turnout system and improvement of turnout performance, which is beneficial to the construction of railroad safety and intelligence. The experiment shows that the correct rate reaches more than 95% and good results are achieved.

articleTitle: Physical Layer Security Communication of Cognitive UAV Mobile Relay Network
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: We consider that in order to improve the utilization rate of spectrum resources and the security rate of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) Communication system, a secure transmission scheme of UAV relay assisted cognitive radio network (CRN) is proposed. In the presence of primary users and eavesdroppers, the UAV acts as the decoding and forwarding mobile relay to assist the secure transmission from the source node to the legitimate destination node. This paper optimizes the flight trajectory and transmission power of the UAV relay to maximize the security rate. Since the design problem is nonconvex, the original problem is approximated to a convex constraint by constructing a surrogate function with nonconvex constraints, and an iterative algorithm based on continuous convex approximation is used to solve the problem. The simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively improve the average security rate of the secondary system and successfully optimize the UAV trajectory.

articleTitle: Research on Railway Obstacle Detection Method Based on Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: In view of the shortcomings of machine vision detection, such as lack of real-time, short sight distance and poor environmental adaptability, a railway foreign object detection method based on microwave radar is proposed. The error correction function of radar is obtained by off-line error correction. According to the railway safety clearance standard, radar measurement parameters and radar lateral measurement error, the clearance area under radar coordinate system is constructed, and the objects in the area are identified, and the moving targets within the radar detection range are filtered and tracked. Finally, the machine vision and radar field test are compared, the results show that the radar detection performance is good, the real-time performance is high, the comprehensive detection rate is about 90%, and it is more suitable for complex railway operation environment.

articleTitle: Vibration analysis of IEC 61373 standard based on measured data
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: The random vibration fatigue strength test of auxiliary equipment of urban rail vehicles in China is mainly conducted according to IEC61373-2010 standard. As the standard is summarized and formulated on the basis of European vehicle operation environment, whether it can meet the domestic vehicle operation environment needs further research. In this paper, the measured data of axle box and frame position of typical lines newly opened, operated for 3 years and more than 6 years in China are selected to calculate the total value of vibration acceleration and acceleration power spectral density, and the results are compared with the corresponding indexes in IEC61373-2010 standard. The analysis results show that there are high-frequency vibration beyond the standard loading frequency range, the vibration magnitude of the frame position of the operating line is greater than that of the IEC61373-2010 standard test vibration level, the IEC61373-2010 standard vibration load spectrum can not reflect the real vibration environment of domestic vehicles.

articleTitle: Research on Open Source Solutions of Data Collection for Industrial Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Nowadays, the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) plays a crucial role in the Industrial Revolution known as Industry 4.0. IIoT requires a full connection among machines, between information technology (IT) systems and operational technology (OT) systems. Various industrial protocols coexist in the field make data collection of IIoT to be a complex work. A Python-based open source solution of data collection for IIoT is proposed, data can be collected by industrial protocols, converted to OPC UA, MQTT, and stored into time-series databases. IIoT data collection can be implemented in a low-cost and flexible way, which is a good supplement to commercial software that can greatly promote the development of the IIoT.

articleTitle: Research on Railroad Turnout Fault Diagnosis Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Turnout is an important signal equipment to ensure the safe operation of train traffic, and its reliability is crucial to the safety and efficiency of railroad transportation. The maintenance of turnouts is mainly based on experience and relevant knowledge for periodic maintenance. There are many problems with this method, such as inaccurate fault location, slow fault analysis, and low work efficiency. Therefore, it will affect the efficiency of driving. Taking S700K type speed switch as the research object, the basic principle of switch control circuit and common switch faults are analyzed, and combined with microcomputer monitoring, the support vector machine (SVM) based algorithm is used for fault diagnosis in view of the complexity of fault diagnosis, and compared with two algorithms of neural network (BP) and Bayesian network (NB). The results show that the fault diagnosis is better by using SVM-based algorithm.

articleTitle: A high precision modeling and calculation method of ship shaft frequency electromagnetic field based on electric dipole
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Shaft-rate electromagnetic field is a kind of signal with obvious electromagnetic characteristics in the physical field of ships. Therefore, the study of shaft-rate electromagnetic field is of great significance to ship electromagnetic protection. Based on the Maxwell's equations in the electromagnetic field theory and the two-layer media conditions of air and seawater as the background to derive the approximate analytical expressions of the electric and magnetic fields generated by horizontal time-harmonic electric dipoles and vertical time-harmonic electric dipoles in seawater. This paper used MATLAB to calculate the electric and magnetic field distribution in 10m and 50m seawater. Finally, a simple edge current model of two-layer dielectric was built in COMSOL without affecting the accuracy of the calculation. The comparative analysis results show that the derived formula can calculate the electric field and magnetic field at different depths in seawater. The analytical solution accuracy of the electric field intensity X and Y components of the horizontal electric dipole is higher, the analytical solution accuracy of the electric field intensity Z component and the three components of the magnetic flux density is higher. The calculation accuracy of different components using different analytical solutions can reach up to 96%.

Author Keywords: Vertical time-harmonic electric dipole Finite element

articleTitle: Design of Steering Wheel and Magnetic Shift Mechanism of FSAE Racing Car
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: As the direct control mechanism of the driver to control the car, the steering wheel plays a very important role. It has high requirements in stability, strength and ergonomics. FSAE racing car usually has a paddle shift mechanism. A well-designed steering wheel can meet the driver's comfort of driving for a long time. At the same time, a more tactile and reliable shift mechanism is conducive to the driver's more convenient control of the transmission gear when driving on the track, so as to give full play to the performance of the car.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-channel Parallel Test System Based on 485 Bus
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of automatization and low efficiency in the circuit test of the trial product of a certain type of fuze in the scientific research stage, as well as the application requirements of batch testing in the later production stage, a multi-channel parallel test system based on the 485 bus was designed. The parallel test system can realize the parallel test of 100 fuze circuits at a time, and on the premise of ensuring the test accuracy, the automation degree and efficiency of the fuze circuit test are improved.

articleTitle: Remote infrared monitoring method for faults of indoor patrol robot in substation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: In view of the low efficiency and accuracy of the traditional substation fault monitoring method and the large limitation of the use conditions, this paper studies the remote infrared monitoring method of substation indoor patrol robot fault. After the infrared image acquired by the robot is enhanced, the object to be monitored in the image is identified. The relationship between the color component of image pixels and the temperature is established to complete the fault monitoring. The experimental results show that the average fault detection accuracy of the proposed method is 98.16% and the monitoring sensitivity is higher.

articleTitle: Speed Curve Optimization of High-speed Flying Train Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: High-speed Flying Train (HFT) with a maximum speed of 4,000km/h can greatly improve the efficiency of travel. The automatic operation control of the train is a very complicated process, requiring high safety but also high comfort and low energy consumption. HFT is automatically controlled using high-speed mode curves, which is a multi-objective optimization problem. To address this problem, this paper proposes an improved genetic algorithm to optimize the multi-objective control model for automatic operating curve. First, a multi-objective model of operation control is established, which is based on the characteristics of HFT. Then, an automatic operation control algorithm based on improved genetic algorithm is developed for HFT, adding a sort operator to make it more suitable for the operation control system. Finally, the algorithm is validated by the simulation on a 50km route with speed limits. The results show that the optimized automatic operation curve can meet the above-mentioned indexes, which proves the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of 2.45GHz High-gain Antenna that Based on Air-ground Ad-hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: For the needs of wireless ad hoc network nodes to achieve long-distance communication, a four-element microstrip array antenna with high gain and broadband is designed, and studied its array design method. The antenna design is carried out in ANSYS HFSS simulation software, and continuous simulation and optimization. The antenna array measure and simulation results are in good agreement. The results of the measures show: The antenna array has a VSWR <; 2 in the 2.2~2.7GHz frequency band, relative bandwidth is 20.6%. Gain 11.8dBi at frequency 2.45Ghz, the size of each layer is 160mm×160mm×2mm. Combine air-ground integration wireless ad-hoc network platform for experiment, through the point-to-point communication experiment, the maximum distance of measures reached 879 meters, compared with the traditional 2.4GHz~2.5GHz antenna, the communication distance is increased by 6~8 times.

articleTitle: Development of Endoscope Inspection Robot System For Water and Gas Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Point at the problems of low efficiency, inaccurate detection effect and unsafe detection process in pipeline detection, this paper designs an endoscopic detection robot for water and gas pipeline system, which uses digital image processing technology of inertial navigation data and computer vision technology. It mainly includes two parts: mechanical structure design and testing software design. The detection robot automatically collects the inner wall information of the pipeline, and the detection software uses the inertial navigation data to de blur, segment and then splice the image, and detects, identifies, locates and classifies the defects in the image, and automatically generates the detection report. The detection process is faster and the detection results are more accurate, which have been verified by step experiments. The system reduces the dependence of detection process on operators and ensures the safety of detection personnel.

articleTitle: Design of excitation signal source based on pulsed eddy currenttechnology in pipeline detection system
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: In this paper, the design of the excitation signal module of pulsed eddy current testing system was designed. The pulse waveform signal excitation module with adjustable parameters was designed by Direct Digital Frequency Synthesis technology according to the characteristics of pulsed eddy current testing system. The excitation signal generation module is divided into three parts, including control module, DDS module and power amplifier circuit. Through the MCU AT89S52 to achieve the control of DDS chip AD9851, signal was regulated by filter circuit and power amplification circuit, the positive and negative pulse square wave signal generated by the prompting signal module can be adjusted by 0~70MHz, and the duty cycle of the signal can be adjusted by 1%<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">~</sub>99%.

articleTitle: Current Status and Key Issues of HVDC Transmission Research: A Brief Review
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: With the construction of the Global Energy Internet, the current social resources, ecological environment, and climate conditions have been alleviated to a certain extent. The realization and improvement of HVDC transmission technology is an inevitable choice for the development of the Global Energy Internet. This article will review the status quo and existing technical problems of UHV DC transmission systems, and point out the difficulties and research directions of the current Voltage source converter (VSC) and Line commutated converter (LCC) technologies, which are expected to provide future development for hybrid DC transmission systems.

articleTitle: Research on Magnetic Fluid and its Application in Gas Flow Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Magnetic fluid is a liquid magnetic material which could reflect the changes of magnetic field rapidly. For application research, the characteristics of magnetic fluid such as supermagnetism, lubricity and fluidity were introduced and analyzed. A gas flow sensor was designed and researched utilizing the magnetic fluid as a sensing medium. The combination of the magnetic fluid and magnet was designed as the magnetic core in the flow sensor. The structure of the flow sensor was designed and analyzed. The measuring work principle of the gas flow sensor with magnetic fluid was studied. By calculating and analyzing, the flow for measuring is related to the parameters including the elasticity coefficient of the spring, the motion distance of the magnetic core, the moving time of the magnetic core, the cross section area of the magnetic core, and the cross section of the measuring pipe for the gas passing through. The gas flow sensor with magnetic fluid is efficient and feasible.

articleTitle: Analysis of vibration characteristics of the centrifugal pump base on CFD
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Marine centrifugal pump is one of the important factors that cause ship vibration, so the research on centrifugal pump vibration is particularly important. In this paper, in order to study the flow-induced vibration characteristics of centrifugal pump, a virtual prototype model of the centrifugal pump is established in finite element method. The theory of Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is utilized to analyze the inner flow field of the centrifugal pump, and steady-state calculation and transient calculation of the flow field are completed. The fluid forces acquired from the transient calculation results of flow field are used as the excitation loads for the virtual prototype model of the centrifugal pump. The fluid-solid coupling model of the centrifugal pump is built, and the vibration acceleration of the centrifugal pump's foot is calculated, and the flow-induced vibration characteristics of the centrifugal pump are obtained. The data of the centrifugal pump measured in the experiment are consistent with the simulation results. This study provide reference for the fluid-solid coupling method in centrifugal pump fluid field prediction and flow-induced vibration research.

articleTitle: Design of dredging device for immersed gravel bed and analysis of water jet
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of silt removal of the gravel bed during the construction of the immersed tube tunnel, a new type of dredging device for the gravel bed of the immersed tube was designed. On the basis of not disturbing the gravel bed, water jet is used to blow the silt on the bed, and the dredging pump is used to remove the silt on the gravel bed of the immersed tunnel. Based on the theory of submerged jets, a mathematical calculation model of water jets is established. By using CFD simulation technology, the law of action between jet pressure and jet velocity is studied. The research results show that the jet flow velocity changes significantly under different jet pressures and the jet pressure and flow velocity are positively correlated. The research results can provide a theoretical reference for the design of dredging system for immersed gravel bed.

articleTitle: Adaptive filtering method for removing engine interference frequency
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: This paper proposes a method combining bandpass filter and adaptive notch filter to remove interference signals generated by engine ignition frequency. Firstly, The report analyzes the interference of engine ignition frequency to the system in the process of implementing the indirect tire pressure monitoring system; then introduces the relationship between the engine's interference frequency and speed. At last, according to the characteristics of the interference frequency and useful signal, a method combining bandpass filter and adaptive notch filtering is proposed to remove the interference frequency. The experiment shows that frequency interference exists, and the method proposed in this paper can obviously reduce the influence of interference frequency.

articleTitle: Design of NOR FLASH data read-write controller based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of local non-volatile storage of a large amount of parameter data when the embedded platform processes a large amount of image data. A high-speed data read-write controller of 128Mbit Flash N25128A13ESEA0F is designed and implemented based on Xilinx K-7 series FPGA using VHDL hardware description language. The PC computer sends the data to the Flash controller through the serial port. And the controller stores the data in the designated location of the Flash. When the embedded platform is powered on next time, this controller can automatically read the required data and provide it to the FPGA internal high-speed image processing logic unit for use. The controller can work at a working frequency of 50MHz with a data throughput rate of 25MByte/s. And this design of Flash read-write controller can meet the basic requirements of an embedded platform Flash data throughput rate> 20MByte/s. After verification on the board, it can correctly read and write Flash data. And Flash data read-write controller was successfully applied in 2000fps high-speed image non-uniformity correction processing unit.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of the Implementation Plan of Network Security Level Protection of Information Security
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Information security is a widely discussed topic in the era of big data. With the rapid development of computer networks, various information security issues have frequently occurred. How to improve the level of computer network information security protection through the implementation of network security level protection is the direction that network security should focus on. Based on the existing security technology and products combined with the information security level protection system, this paper analyzes the relevant technical management requirements of the scheme design, and studies the design method and design process.

articleTitle: Structure Design of Magnetization Device of Magnetic Leakage Internal Detector for Small-Diameter Oil and Gas Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: In view of the relatively high requirements for the passability of equipment for small-diameter pipelines, through the magnetic circuit analysis of the magnetization structure of the intelligent magnetic flux leakage detection robot, designed a magnetization structure scheme that uses mechanical structure to adjust the movement posture and meet the detection requirements of the magnetization mechanism. The magnetic circuit characteristics generated by different permanent magnet parameters were used to carry out the finite element simulation of the magnetization structure of the variable diameter pipeline magnetic flux leakage detector through the magnetization process of the pipeline. The effect of changing the permanent magnet parameters on the detection results was determined, and the rationality of the scheme was preliminarily verified, to provide technical support for the development of life prediction and scientific management of small-diameter pipelines.

articleTitle: PID control method of oil pipeline welding heat treatment with constant velocity temperature rise
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: The quality of the temperature control algorithm of the medium frequency induction heating power supply will directly affect the quality and efficiency of welding, and too low temperature may lead to insufficient hardness of the workpiece. Excessive temperature will cause excessive thermal stress of the workpiece and lead to quenching. Induction heating temperature control system has the characteristics of non-linearity, strong interference and large lag. In view of the complexity of the medium frequency induction heating system, this paper applies the constant velocity temperature control method to the heating system of the medium frequency power supply large workpiece. In the PID (proportional integral differential) algorithm on the basis of the control of intermediate frequency power supply at a constant heating rate according to the requirement of TP347 Φ 508 pipeline girth for heat treatment. Experiments have proved that the PID-based constant-speed heating control method is suitable for the intermediate frequency induction heating tube blank temperature control system. The application of this control method to the production site also shows the effectiveness of the method, and the results show that the control temperature meets the requirements of the production process.

articleTitle: Application of Text Error Correction Algorithm in Railway Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: This paper proposes an error detection and error correction algorithm for speech recognition text based on statistics and understanding, in order to optimize speech recognition results. Through experiments, the accuracy rate of the algorithm proposed in this paper is 82.1%, which can effectively correct the errors in the text after speech recognition and realize the application of speech recognition technology in the field of railway signals. This paper has solved the problem of low recognition rate of professional language in the field of railway signal by speech recognition systems.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of the data prediction model based on PSO-ELM
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) is currently a very popular type of machine learning algorithm, which is used to train a single layer feedforward neural network (SLFN). Aiming at the drawback that the ELM method cannot independently optimize the optimal network, this study uses the particle swarm algorithm to select the optimal hidden layer deviation and input weight matrix. The proposed PSO-ELM method is compared with the traditional ELM method in simulation. The accuracy of the prediction results on different gasoline octane content data has been improved. Finally, the conclusion and some potential research are summarized.

articleTitle: Application Process Algorithm Analysis of RFID Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Using the basic principle of wireless signal transmission and RFID technology, using the method of system engineering, the comprehensive experiment of RFID is carried out in the Internet of things system. In order to solve the RFID technology, how to apply in the Internet of things system, this paper discusses the working process and identification process of RFID. The composition principle and signal recognition algorithm of RFID are analyzed. Through the analysis and explanation of the recognition algorithm, as well as a large number of experimental verifications, a large number of data and analysis results are obtained. It provides reliable basis and feasible identification algorithm for the further application and development of RFID technology.

articleTitle: Integration And Experimental Study Of Automatic Driving System For Bus
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, the automobile industry presents a good development prospect. Especially, the application of new technology and new equipment, and the automatic driving technology have gradually entered people's vision. The automatic driving system of bus planning and design is essentially in order to escape from the wrong operation of the driver, automatically perceive the hidden danger in driving, reasonably plan and control, and avoid the occurrence of safety accidents to the greatest extent. Based on the actual requirements of bus automatic driving integration, combined with the characteristics of bus, this paper studies the system architecture and core control technology of automatic driving technology on bus. In this paper, multi-sensor data fusion, high-precision positioning, secondary path planning and other control technology means are determined, and then the perception system, decision-making system, execution system are designed and implemented to complete the design of automatic driving bus. Finally, the function, performance, reliability and other aspects of the designed automatic driving bus are tested. The test results show that the vehicle meets the basic actual needs and the expected design objectives, and can realize L3 level automatic driving under the conditions of low-speed closed Park, expressway and urban expressway.

articleTitle: Fatigue analysis of ship-borne modular skid-mounted equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: In order to ensure the fatigue reliability of ship borne modular skid mounted structure, the fatigue reliability of skid mounted structure under wave load is studied by using fatigue accumulation theory. Firstly, according to the statistical characteristics of waves in the South China Sea, the fatigue loads of ship mounted skid structures with different wave directions are calculated by using hydrodynamic analysis method, and then the fatigue life of skid structures is analyzed by using nominal stress method and S-N curve. The results show that the joint between the fracturing skid and the deck is prone to fatigue damage. When the incident angle of the wave is 90 degrees, the fatigue life damage of the ship mounted skid structure is the largest. Therefore, the ship should keep the same direction with the wave direction as far as possible during the mooring operation, so as to reduce the damage of wave load to the skid mounted equipment.

articleTitle: Method for generating variable magnetic field based on Helmholtz coil and its simulation research
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Aiming at the needs of laboratory testing of the fuze's geomagnetometer speed measurement function, this paper proposes a method of adding alternating current to the Helmholtz coil to generate a changing magnetic field. This method can accurately simulate the changing magnetic field environment when the muzzle projectile of the fuze rotates at a high speed in dynamic shooting, and can effectively control the intensity and changing frequency of the generated magnetic field by adjusting the frequency and amplitude of the coil excitation voltage. Simulation verification shows that this method can generate the external changing magnetic field environment required for the fuze meter speed measurement function test, and has high precision and accuracy.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis and prediction of accelerometer servo circuit based on machine learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: In view of the numerous uncertain factors in the manufacturing of quartz flexible accelerometer servo circuit, the tolerance effects of internal component parameters and fuzzy failure location, this paper proposed a network structure algorithm based on machine learning. The algorithm learnt and was trained according to the output function parameters of the circuit, in order to accurately determine the cause of the circuit fault and locate the fault through quantitative analysis. Through the measurement data in the production process, our algorithm has an accuracy rate of 99.6% of circuit failure factor prediction. The application of the algorithm can effectively improve circuit testing efficiency and manufacturing yield. Furthermore, it can be extended to other electronic equipment manufacturing fields showing a high engineering applicable significance.

articleTitle: Research on modeling and solving algorithm of steelmaking continuous casting production scheduling
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: As a large-scale industrial consumer, the efficient and stable operation of iron and steel industry has an important impact on the development of national economy. In this paper, the modeling and solving algorithm of steelmaking continuous casting production scheduling process are studied in detail. First of all, considering the stability of the system operation and the timely completion of the production plan, the two objective functions are to minimize the advance/delay time of all casts and the makespan, respectively. Secondly, based on the analysis of steelmaking continuous casting process, a variety of process constraints are proposed. Combining with the two objective functions, the steelmaking continuous casting production scheduling problem model is constructed. Then, aiming at the shortcomings of the traditional particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm and genetic algorithm (GA), the improved particle swarm optimization (IPSO) and improved genetic algorithm (IGA) are proposed, and IGA-IPSO algorithm is proposed by combining them. Finally, five different algorithms are used to solve the proposed model, and the results show the superiority of IGA-IPSO algorithm in solving the proposed model.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent bedroom system based on pure off-line speech recognition technology
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Due to the popularity of the network, most smart home [1] and intelligent products need to be connected to the Internet to improve the degree of intelligence. However, these products are excessively dependent on the Internet. In order to avoid the excessive reliance of intelligent products on the Internet and improve the life quality and Intelligent degree of majority of users, this paper proposes an intelligent bedroom system based on pure off-line speech recognition technology, namely: the system does not need to connect the network and will can run well and complete the work of the intelligent bedroom system. The system has the characteristics of good identification effect, stable, reliable performance, low customer development difficulty, short product development cycle and high customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis of Station Computer Interlocking in Railway Station
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Railway signal system is an important infrastructure to ensure safe operation, loaded safe operation of railway, It has the characteristics of high scientific and technological content and complex security system. The safety of each signal subsystem determines the reliability and safety of the whole system, which takes computer interlocking equipment at ground station as an example, through a comprehensive safety risk analysis of the interlocking system, build a risk matrix based on risk frequency and risk severity, form a risk confidence interval. The constructed risk confidence interval provides a reference method for the safety assessment of the high-speed railway signal system.

articleTitle: Development and Design of Variable Back Pressure Exhaust System for FSC Racing Car
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: It was universally acknowledged that the engine is the core component for a racing car, and the exhaust part of the engine is one of the important factors affecting the engine power output. In previous races, teams used direct exhaust, but through simulation experiments, it can be found that this exhaust will cause torque loss at low speed. Therefore, some domestic schools have added the exhaust back pressure drum in the exhaust system, which solves the problem of torque loss at low speed. However, in the case of high engine speed and large exhaust volume, it will hinder the discharge of air flow and affect the engine power. For this reason, we plan to study the variable exhaust back pressure drum. Before that, this technology only appeared in F1 and some high-performance passenger cars, and has not been used in domestic FSC teams. This paper plans to design a variable back pressure device for the engine through CATIA, GT power and other modeling and simulation software. Through continuous optimization, the device can achieve the purpose of eliminating the above adverse effects and maximizing the engine power. At the same time, it pursues lower back pressure and quality of the exhaust pipe. Combined with the engine bench test, the reliability of the simulation results is analyzed assessment.

articleTitle: Washing type air purifier based on selective sinking speed bump
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Nowadays, with the development of science and technology, the extensive use of cars has caused pollution to the environment. The roads for cars are generally equipped with speed bump, which waste considerable energy while slowing down. Based on the above situation, the project team designed a Washing type air purifier device consisted of three parts of falling speed bump, transmission mechanism and air purifying device. Through the cooperation of the gear and rack, connecting rod, flywheel and chain and other mechanical structures,the device can recover and reuse the energy wasted by vehicles passing through the speed bump at an appropriate speed, and finally achieve the effect of purifying the air. For the vehicles passing by at high speed, the speed bump is selectively kept without sinking, and the original punishment mechanism of speed bump is still retained for such vehicles. The coordination of each part effectively alleviates the problem of energy waste and air pollution when the car passes through the speed bump, which has high practical value and popularization value.

articleTitle: An algorithm for approximate lower limit of grey TSP
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Travelling Salesman Problem is a well known problem in operations research. TSP is short for The Travelling Salesman Problem. The general idea is that a peddler travels from one town, through many towns once, only once, and then returns to the original town, asking how to choose the route that will make the journey the shortest. In daily life, many problems can be reduced to this kind of problem. In fact, due to some conditions, the exact distance between the two towns can not be determined. By introducing the theory and concept of Grey for TSP, the grey TSP problem is produced. In this paper, the grey element is introduced into the Travelling Salesman Problem, and based on the grey traveling salesman model, a method of calculating the approximate lower limit of the Travelling Salesman Problem is given by reasoning proof.

articleTitle: A new method of infrared small target recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: It is always a difficult challenge to detect small infrared targets under complex background and ensure high detection rate and low false alarm rate. In this paper, a detection method based on morphological Top-hat filtering and local energy difference is proposed. This method utilizes the advantage that morphological Top-hat filter can suppress the backgTround, and then segmented the image based on local energy difference to identify small targets. In this paper, the specific detection process of this method is given, and a number of small infrared target grayscale images under complex background are selected for the simulation experiment. The experimental results show that this method has a high detection rate and a low false alarm rate, and is of certain reference value for the detection of small infrared targets under complex background.

articleTitle: Research on the Competitiveness and Complementarity of Foreign Trade in Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui and Shanghai under the Background of Integration of the Yangtze River Delta
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: The Yangtze River Delta urban agglomeration is located in East China, which is an important starting point for the "Belt and Road" Initiative and the leader of the Yangtze River Economic Belt. High expectations are placed in the socialist modernization drive and the economic layout of opening up. As the most developed region of China's economy, and also China's largest foreign trade export base, foreign trade has always played an irreplaceable role in its economic development. This paper first analyses the current situation of foreign trade development in Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui and Shanghai, then uses the dominant comparative advantage index, export similarity index to analyze the competitiveness of foreign trade in three provinces and one city. Subsequently, the paper adopts the trade combination index, trade specialization index to analyze the complementarity situation of foreign trade between the Yangtze River Delta and its main trading partners, and on this basis. At last, some relevant ccountermeasures and suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Beidou positioning and RFID module integrated peripherals
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: RFID is an important means of life cycle management of power assets. However, RFID can only realize the full visibility of assets and real-time update of information within a certain range, and can only locate in a certain range, which can not meet the needs of accurate positioning. In this paper, through the RFID assets physical electronic identification, the design of long-distance ultra-high radio frequency technology, the design of integrated UHF radio frequency module; the research of high-precision Beidou Positioning Technology, design of integrated high-precision positioning module. According to the above two modules, the peripherals integrating Beidou Positioning and RFID are designed to connect the mobile terminals of various business departments.

articleTitle: Intelligent Shop Floor Scheduling by an Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Manufacturing industry can directly reflect the level of national productivity, and energy-saving. Efficient intelligent manufacturing can be realized via utilizing the optimization of production scheduling. In this paper, according to the actual situation of flexible job-shop scheduling problem, a mathematical model is established to minimize both the maximum completion time and the energy consumption of processing machines. The coding method, generation of initial population, evolution stage and selection operation of the algorithm are optimized, aiming to improve the shortcomings of the genetic algorithm, the convergence speed of the algorithm as well as the quality of the final optimal solution. A machine-process double layer coding scheme based on roulette probability selection machine is designed to ensure that the machine segment coding can meet the requirement of minimum completion time. In order to improve the quality of the initial population, a method of generating the initial population is designed to make the initial population evenly distributed in the solution space. The evolutionary process is divided into two parts, namely, crossover in the early stage and mutation in the later stage. In addition, the population diversity can be improved, and the proposed algorithm can avoid falling into the local optimal. Simulation results verify the stability of the improved genetic algorithm and the effectiveness and feasibility of the flexible job-shop scheduling. The job-shop scheduling operators can select a group of feasible solutions for job-shop scheduling according to different weights and actual conditions.

articleTitle: Buckling analysis of four-column frame structure of large-tonnage steel strand tensile testing machine
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: This paper takes the four-column frame structure of the 1000kN large-tonnage steel strand tensile testing machine as the object to conduct stability research. The theoretical critical load of the structure is calculated by the Euler formula, and the linear buckling analysis is conducted based on ANSYS Workbench. The comparison between the two results shows that the finite element analysis is feasible. On this basis, the nonlinear buckling analysis is performed. The result shows that the four-column structure has good stability, and it is found that the initial processing defects have a great influence on the structural bearing capacity.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization of key parameters of centrifugal pump based on 3D dimensional chain
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: The orifice ring gap has a great influence on the performance of centrifugal pump, but there are few researches on the key parameters related to the orifice ring gap. In this paper, the 3D dimensional chain model of radial runout of the outer cylindrical surface of the impeller orifice ring end relative to the reference of the pump shaft is established. The key parameters are optimized through the calculation and analysis of the 3D dimensional model, and the qualified rate of radial runout is improved. An optimized solution is provided to ensure the size of orifice ring gap.

articleTitle: "Ore Mining "in the game " Red Alert "and different roads for mining development in the United States and Soviet Union
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: This article is not a serious scientific paper, by reviewing the classic game "Red Alert ", this paper compares the infrastructure, weapons and equipment of the US-Soviet camp and discusses the development of heavy industry in the United States and the Soviet Union since the middle of the 20th century, especially the different road of mining industry development. The latter part of the article focuses on the analysis of the development of mining industry in the 21st century.

articleTitle: Design and Manufacture of Carbon Fiber Seat for Formula Electric Car
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: In order to improve the adaptability and safety of the driver's cab, this paper takes the racing seats of Formula Student Electric China (FSEC) as the research object, applies the ergonomics theory and combines with the actual needs of FSEC drivers to analyze the adaptability and comfort of the driver's cab. Carbon fiber composites are used as raw materials to meet the requirements of lightweight and high stiffness. In the aspect of seat modeling design, the ergonomics module of CATIA software is used to evaluate the comfort, and the human-machine test bench is used to analyze the adaptability and safety. The stacking scheme analysis and optimization design are carried out based on the composite material processing module of ANSYS finite element analysis software.

articleTitle: Research on the visualization method of two dimensions underwater flow simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: The simulation and visualization of the flow field integrated into the rendering of the underwater scene is the key direction of the research work in the field of augmented reality in recent years. The underwater scene visualization framework of this article includes two parts: two dimensions flow simulation and visualization rendering. The flow field simulation is based on the NS equation solution, and the solution of the fluid dynamics equation is also the most computationally intensive. Therefore, use CUDA to write multiple kernel functions to solve the N-S equation multiple times. This method avoids the time overhead of setting up and accessing textures. Using CUDA can control the characteristics of a variety of fast memory (shared memory, texture memory share memory, texture memory), and the algorithm can be executed more efficiently. The visualization framework of underwater flow simulation adopts OpenGL and GLSL. The final experimental results show that better visual effects can be obtained with more than 80 iterations.

articleTitle: Vehicle target detection in special parkinglot based on feature clustering
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: At present, the management system of ordinary residential parkinglot for civilian use is relatively complete, but there is a lot of room for development in parkinglot management under special circumstances such as public security department, confidential department, and security department. Among them, in particular, the vehicle target detection still uses simple license plate recognition, which is the recognition and detection method used in ordinary parkinglots, but this has huge safety hazards for special occasions parkinglots with high safety requirements. In this regard, this article proposes a method for vehicle target detection in special parkinglots, specifically combining the bee colony algorithm with the clustering model, and inspired by team management, the method and team of honeybees in the bee colony clustering algorithm The advantages and disadvantages of the working methods of the members in management make up for each other, forming the parallel intelligent bee colony clustering under the team management mode of this article. A similarity measurement function is reconstructed and calculated for determining the degree of similarity to achieve the purpose of specific vehicle target detection. The simulation results show that the vehicle target detection method based on clustering analysis has good applicability. The average detection integrity rate and the average detection accuracy rate of the test set are 86.38% and 71.25%, respectively, which are higher compared to those of other methods. It can meet the parkinglot management under special occasions.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Design of industrial robot teaching based on unity3D
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Industrial robot application technology is an important course for mechanical college students, and robot is a kind of relatively expensive equipment. So in the daily learning process of robots, there may not be so many objects for everyone to learn and train. In this paper, virtual reality technology is used to simulate the industrial robot and its scene. In this paper, three-dimensional modeling is completed by Solidworks software, and the industrial robot body is constructed. Then this paper uses 3DS Max software to model the application environment, assembly line and classroom which need industrial robot. Finally, this paper uses Unity3D software for virtual reality programming and simulation design. Through the design, this paper based on virtual reality technology for industrial robot technology and application courses teaching, building the basic line. This has laid a solid foundation for the later stage virtual reality technology to perfect the aspect of teaching.

articleTitle: The application of rubber supporting system on the railway vehicle carbody structure modal test
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: The paper mainly discusses about the influence of the railway vehicle carbody supporting system on the rigid body mode and elastic mode in the modal test or the physical parameter identification test. Different rubbers are connected in series to change the support stiffness, the dynamic and static stiffness of rubber support is tested, then CAE modal analysis and modal test are carried out to compare the rigid body modal frequency and elastic modal frequency of the railway vehicle carbody structure under different support stiffness; It is concluded that different stiffness supports have certain influence on the elastic mode, which has engineering application value for improving the modal parameters identification accuracy of the railway vehicle carbody structure.

articleTitle: The research on cemented carbide tool wear
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: The purpose of the research on tool wear mechanism is to analyze the physical, chemical and mechanical phenomena in the contact area of the friction pair formed by the tool and the workpiece, and to find out the causes of the tool wear and the methods to reduce the tool wear. In this paper, we use scanning electron microscope and energy dispersive spectrometer to study the tool wear pattern and mechanism of tool wear in high-speed cutting of titanium alloy TC21. The engineering solution of the problem is concluded, which has certain engineering application value and theoretical research value.

articleTitle: Research on Impulse Noise Suppression Method of Power Line Communication Based on Cross-correlation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: Impulse noise have an important influence on the communication quality of low voltage power lines. Based on the actual noise of industrial scene, the time-domain characteristics of typical impulse noise and the cross-correlation between three-phase noise are analyzed, and an impulse noise suppression method based on adaptive filtering algorithms is proposed. The performance is verified by building a bit error rate simulation platform of power line communication based on QPSK modulation. The results show that the impulse noise suppression method based on LMS and NLMS algorithms has significant improvement effect on bit error rate.

articleTitle: Unbalance response of pump shaft based on tolerances
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: This paper takes a certain type of centrifugal pump rotor as the research object. The relationship between tolerance levels and unbalance response will be discussed considering the current machining standards. A finite element model of the rotor was established. The concentricity and circular run-out of the second and third shaft segments, the verticality of the convex cover, the circular run-out of the iron core and the run-out of the impeller end were used as the research objectives. Several tolerance levels were chosen, and each the tolerance level is converted into an unbalance mass to calculate the unbalanced response of the shaft system. The calculation results show that the verticality error of the convex cover and the impeller runout have the greatest influence on the vibration of the shafting.

articleTitle: Design of desilting mechanism for sewer desilting robot
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: With the development of the city, the drainage pipe of the city sewer is faced with serious blockage. The desilting working environment of urban sewer is bad and the operating space is narrow. This makes it very difficult for people to work. These make some cities often appear "look at the sea" phenomenon. In this paper, the design of desilting part of desilting robot is studied. This paper focuses on how to control the pneumatic work intelligently according to the condition of the silt and drive the rotary blade to clear the silt. In this paper, three-dimensional modeling and two-dimensional drawing of the designed dredging robot are carried out by using SolidWorks, AUTOCAD and other software. In this paper, the main characteristics of the desilting mechanism are analyzed, the mechanical part of the desilting robot is optimized, and the low cost is designed.

articleTitle: Application of Computer 3D Modeling Technology in Ceramic Tea Set Design
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: This paper analyzes the computer modeling technology and its application in ceramic tea set design, including 3DX MAX computer modeling technology, application of 3D model in ceramic tea set design and application of computer modeling technology in ceramic tea set design. Then it analyzes the application of basic computer modeling methods in ceramic tea set design, including lofting modeling, extrusion modeling and turning modeling; Then, it expounds the application of advanced computer modeling in the design of ceramic tea set; Finally, it analyzes the commonly used auxiliary instructions of computer modeling technology in ceramic tea set design, including bump mapping and Boolean algebra. Through this paper, we hope that relevant people will have more understanding of the application of computer 3D modeling technology in ceramic tea set design, and pay more attention to the use of computer 3D modeling technology to assist ceramic tea set design.

articleTitle: Construction of Wisdom Campus in Western Yunnan Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology in Colleges and universities, the application of big data in the field of education is also gradually promoted. Based on the analysis of the existing cases of wisdom campus construction in Colleges and universities, combined with the characteristics of Local Application-oriented Colleges and universities in western Yunnan, this paper constructs a wisdom campus framework model that meets the needs of localization.

articleTitle: Application Exploration of Photoshop Computer Design Software in Contemporary Art Design
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: With the advent of the information age, the network is developing faster and faster, the computer technology is more and more developed, and the application fields are more and more extensive. With the popularization of computer technology, people pay more and more attention to the progress of the times brought by science and technology, and begin to strengthen the application of computer technology. Among them, people pay special attention to processing design works in the field of art with computers, and at the same time, computer technology has greatly improved people's aesthetic standards. Contemporary art majors pay more and more attention to design details, but those design details and sense of design can't be expressed by traditional painting techniques to a great extent. However, with the development of current social science and technology, computer Photoshop software can realize drawing details, which makes art design works more aesthetic and visual appeal. Therefore, using Photoshop computer design software has become an indispensable course in contemporary art design majors. Photoshop software contains many design elements, which can help students to better mix colors, thus expanding students' awareness of aesthetic art and improving their artistic appreciation ability. This paper mainly explores the application of Photoshop computer software in contemporary art design. Firstly, it analyzes the common functions of Photoshop software. Secondly, it explores the main application fields of Photoshop computer design software in art design. Finally, it summarizes the positive and negative effects of Photoshop software on art design, and puts forward suggestions for improvement.

articleTitle: Investigation on dynamic contact stress of the gear system with structure-thermal coupling field
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Symposium on Mechatronics and Industrial Informatics (ISMII)
abstract: In the case of high speed and heavy load, the operation of gear system is often accompanied by higher temperature. Therefore, the influence of temperature on contact stress cannot be ignored. The dynamic contact stress with thermal-structural coupling exists widely in the gear system. The concept of structural-thermal stress difference is put forward, and the reason of structural -thermal stress difference in gear system is explained theoretically. The theoretical calculation method of structural-thermal stress difference is deduced, and the dynamic contact stress of the gear system under different working conditions is analyzed by finite element method. The instantaneous temperature rise of each point on the tooth surface is calculated, and the correlation between temperature and dynamic thermal contact stress is revealed. The dynamic thermal contact stress and structural contact stress of single tooth meshing zone and double tooth meshing zone under various loads are studied, and the influence rules of different loads on dynamic thermal contact stress are summarized. The analysis of the gear models with different friction coefficients is carried out, and the effect of friction coefficients on structural-thermal stress difference of gears under different loads is revealed. Through the study of the gear systems with different rotational speeds, it is found that the main influencing factors of stress are loads. Finally, the reliability of the finite element method is testified by experiments.
